title: Your medicines today
footer: This card is a reading aid, not medical advice.
confirm: Please confirm with a pharmacist or doctor.

reasons.source_unknown: not sure if printed or handwritten
reasons.name_not_found: name not found in the medicine list
reasons.timing_not_printed_rx: timing not from a printed prescription

queued: Couldn't read right now. Your photo is saved ({n}). Tap "Try again" in a minute.
uses_note: Your doctor may have prescribed it for a different reason.
app_tagline: Take a photo of your medicine strip or prescription. We'll tell you what to take and when, in your language.
step1: Take a clear photo of the strip, box or prescription.
step2: Each medicine is read and checked against a medicine list.
step3: You get a simple card you can also listen to. If we're not sure, we tell you to ask your pharmacist.
reading_wait: This can take up to a minute on a slow network.
privacy: Photos are sent to Google's Gemini service only to read them.
no_photo: Please choose at least one photo.
bad_photo: That file is not a photo we can read.
not_medicine: {n} photo(s) don't look like a medicine strip, box or prescription, so nothing was read from them. Please take a photo of the medicine label.
cam_hint: Hold the label flat and close, in good light. Take one photo per strip or page.
camera_blocked: The camera isn't available here. Please use "Choose photo" instead.
hero_title: Know your medicines from one photo
scan_sub: Use a clear, well-lit photo of the label.
point1: Checks every name against a medicine list
point3: If unsure, it tells you to ask a pharmacist
meta: {a} on your schedule · {b} to check with a pharmacist
history_empty: No readings yet. Take a photo of a medicine strip or prescription to start.
history_note: Saved on this device's browser only. Delete any reading you no longer need.
nothing_read: We couldn't read any medicine names in {n} photo(s). Please show it to your pharmacist or doctor.
offline_mode: Basic reading: the full reading service wasn't available, so only clearly printed names were checked on this phone's server. Tap "Try again" later for a full reading.
urgent: Feeling very unwell? Call 108 for an ambulance
cam_allow: Starting the camera… If your browser asks, tap "Allow".
chat_intro: Your reading and label pictures are attached, so you don't need to explain them. A verified pharmacist will reply here.
chat_waiting: Your question was sent. A pharmacist will reply on this page; you can close it and come back from History.
chat_not_doctor: A pharmacist's reply does not replace your doctor's advice.
chat_too_many: This chat has too many messages. Please visit a pharmacy.
role_patient_sub: Take a photo of a strip, box or prescription
role_pharmacist_sub: Answer questions and confirm readings (verified accounts)
